item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\n\\ndef want(req,ev,pol,exp):\\n    before=copy.deepcopy((req,ev,pol)); got=evaluate(req,ev,pol); assert got==exp,(got,exp); assert (req,ev,pol)==before; assert list(got)==['status','value','sources','unknowns']\\nbase={'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':None}}\\npol={'required_conditions':['b','a'],'require_verified':True}\\nwant({'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1}},[],pol,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['b']})\\nwant(base,[],pol,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']})\\nev=[{'source':'z','claim':'c','value':{'y':2,'x':1},'conditions':{'a':1,'b':None},'verified':True},{'source':'a','claim':'c','value':{'x':1,'y':2},'conditions':{'a':1,'b':None},'verified':True}]\\nwant(base,ev,pol,{'status':'supported','value':{'y':2,'x':1},'sources':['a','z'],'unknowns':[]})\\nev2=ev+[{'source':'m','claim':'c','value':False,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':None},'verified':True}]\\nwant(base,ev2,pol,{'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','m','z'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})\\nwant(base,[{'source':'old','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':None},'verified':True},{'source':'new','claim':'c','value':2,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':None},'verified':True,'supersedes':['old']}],pol,{'status':'supported','value':2,'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]})\\nwant(base,[{'source':'f','claim':'c','value':False,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':None},'verified':True}],pol,{'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['f'],'unknowns':[]})\\nwith open('requests.json') as f: rs=json.load(f)\\nwith open('evidence.json') as f: es=json.load(f)\\nwith open('policy.json') as f: p=json.load(f)\\nwith open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)\\nassert report==[evaluate(r,es,p) for r in rs]\\nprint('all checks passed',len(rs)+6)\"]}"}
